name: THE DISTRICT
note: Room 0, doc 20. Not a painted location -- a drawn plan of the district, clicked to travel. It has no floor, no actor and no hotspots, which is why it declares kind: map: the walk-box, staging and depth checks all reason about a room a person stands in, and this is a menu that looks like a place (doc 20 rule 5). Errata 25 withdrew the character token, so nothing on this screen moves. ERRATA 31b and 31c settle every location that was pending: Boot Hill gates on the undertaker naming Pike dead, and everything visible from Main Street appears the first time Thad stands on it -- two locations become twelve at the moment the town opens.

entrances.note: Doc 20 rule 2: the map is ALWAYS reachable. It is entered from the panel rather than from a doorway, which is why no room exits to it -- a hotspot is a claim about one room and 'always' is a claim about every room. Leaving it returns to whichever room it was opened from, so there is no arrival point and nothing to face.

locations.note: ERRATA 30c, first state: he is standing on it. Ungated -- with the road below it this is the floor of two the map may never go under.

ERRATA 30c, first state: seeing counts, and he can see it from the street. This is the amendment to doc 20 rule 3 -- a player who takes the driver's EXIT option immediately hears nothing, and an empty map on first opening is a broken screen.

locations.label: THE UNDERTAKER'S
locations.note: Doc 20 rule 3 in its original form: heard of, not visited. The driver names him and nobody else in Act I does. Room 13 is not built, so this carries its own label from doc 20 until the room exists to supply one -- and draws dim and untravellable, rather than being hidden, because a location Thad has heard of is on the map whether or not we have drawn it yet.

locations.label: BOOT HILL
locations.note: ERRATA 31b. Doc 20's 'once Pike is mentioned' is VOID: Thad names Ezra Pike to the driver in the opening, and gating on that would put Boot Hill on the map at the coach stop and break 30c's floor of two. It gates on the undertaker saying he is dead.
